reasons.plausibility: Small tungsten additions are well-known to enhance high-temperature strength and corrosion resistance in related alloys, making the proposal sound in principle, though the exact behaviour in this specific HEA composition has some uncertainties.
reasons.testability: They propose a controlled experimental comparison of baseline and W-doped alloys under well-defined creep and corrosion tests, providing a clear criterion for falsification.
reasons.usefulness: Tungsten doping directly addresses known deficiencies in creep and corrosion performance, providing a practical avenue for improving this HEA’s properties.
